text: from light. Profile Methacycline is a tetracycline derivative with uses similar to those of tetracycline (p.347). Like demeclocycline, it is excreted more slowly than tetracycline and effective blood concentrations are maintained for longer periods; the plasma elimination half- life is about 14 hours. Methacycline hydrochloride is given orally in a usual adult dose of 600 mg daily in 2 divided doses, preferably 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals. Preparations USP 31: Methacycline Hydrochloride Capsules; Methacycline Hydrochlo- ride Oral Suspension. Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Fr.: Lysocline; Physiomycine; Ital.: Esarondil; Rotilen; Stafilon.
